offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures motion control products such as motors, drives, controls, actuators and power supplies. Sells them to OEMs and system integrators in industrial, medical, vehicle, aerospace and defense markets, often as custom-engineered solutions.

primary_products.value: brushless and brushed motors; motion controllers and drives; actuators and stepper motors; power supplies and transformers; electronic components and sensors

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEMs and system integrators in industrial, medical, vehicle, aerospace and defense markets; B2G: defense and aerospace programs via prime contractors and agencies

end_markets.value: industrial automation; medical; aerospace and defense; vehicle (off-highway, electric); semiconductor and robotics

revenue_model.value: product sales: custom and standard motion control components and systems

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: manufactures motors, drives, controls and power components from purchased materials, sold to OEMs

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, with manufacturing in the US, Canada, Europe and China

specialization.value: related lines: motion control, power and electronic components sharing customers and engineering

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: engineering-led sales to OEM customers; distributors / dealers: catalog and standard products through distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: defense export controls (ITAR), product safety and environmental rules, medical customers' quality standards
